summary.text: Omar Williams, listed by Ballotpedia as Jawaharial Williams, is a Democratic Illinois state representative who has represented District 10 since 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Omar Williams was appointed to the Illinois House of Representatives in May 2019 to fill the vacancy created when Melissa Conyears-Ervin was elected city treasurer, and he assumed office on May 17, 2019.
Ballotpedia lists him as winning the general elections for District 10 in 2020, 2022 and 2024, and he advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
